name: reactivation_sync_at_risk_customers
description: Sync at-risk customers from Xero churn-risk-ml API to prospects cache. Fetches customers with specified churn risk threshold and enriches with contact details from Xero.
short_description: Sync at-risk customers from Xero ML models

name: reactivation_create_campaign
description: Create a new customer reactivation email campaign. Specify campaign name, target customer segment, email template, discount offer, and scheduling. Returns campaign ID for further operations.

campaign_name.description: Descriptive name for the campaign (e.g., 'Q1 2026 Win-Back')

churn_threshold.description: Minimum churn risk score to include customers (0-100)

template_id.description: Email template ID to use (get from reactivation_list_templates)

subject_line.description: Email subject line (supports merge fields like {{first_name}})

discount_code.description: Discount code to include in emails (e.g., 'WELCOME25')

discount_amount.description: Discount amount (percentage or dollar value depending on discount_type)

campaign_cost.description: Estimated campaign cost for ROI calculation

name: reactivation_add_recipients
description: Add recipients to an existing campaign. Provide array of customer objects with contact details and Xero data. Automatically links to Xero contact IDs for reorder tracking.

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to add recipients to

recipients.description: Array of recipient objects with customer details

churn_risk_score.description: Churn risk score from ML model (0-100)

name: reactivation_send_campaign
description: Send campaign emails to all pending recipients via SendGrid. Automatically personalizes each email with merge fields, adds tracking pixels for opens, and logs all sending events. Updates campaign status to 'completed' when done.

name: reactivation_get_campaign_analytics
description: Get detailed analytics for a campaign including open rates, click rates, reorder conversion, revenue recovered, and event timeline. Shows full ROI calculation with costs vs recovered revenue.

name: reactivation_check_reorders
description: Check Xero for new orders from campaign recipients to track reactivation success. Polls Xero invoices by date range and matches against campaign recipients. Updates reorder status and revenue recovered metrics automatically.
short_description: Check for customer reorders in Xero

campaign_id.description: Campaign ID to check reorders for

name: reactivation_list_templates
description: List all available email templates. Filter by template type (reactivation, win_back, feedback, etc.) or category. Includes pre-built templates with proven subject lines and HTML designs.

user_id.description: User ID to fetch templates for

name: reactivation_create_template
description: Create a new email template with HTML body, subject line, and merge fields. Supports personalization variables like {{first_name}}, {{discount_code}}, {{months_inactive}}, and custom fields. Saves template for reuse across campaigns.

html_body.description: HTML email body with inline CSS and merge fields

name: reactivation_get_dashboard
description: Get dashboard overview with aggregate metrics across all campaigns. Shows total emails sent, open rates, click rates, reorders, revenue recovered, ROI, and at-risk customer counts. Includes list of recent campaigns with performance summaries.

user_id.description: User ID to fetch dashboard for

business_id.description: Xero business ID to filter by (1=Print, 2=Publishing, 3=Signs)
